text.text: I don’t often post negative reviews, but I’m hoping this will benefit future customers. Maybe someone will finish the “renovations” they apparently started. No hairdryer. No iron. Dirty baseboards. Greenish pool. Our door was super hard to open and close. Crappy bathtub drain. Had to hold down the toilet handle to get it to flush. My boys claimed their room didn’t have hot water. Didn’t confirm. Nobody took out our trash. Signs covered. Is this place even supposed to be operating? And when I went on my run this morning and asked to use the lobby bathroom, the guy said it was broken without even asking me if I was a guest there. Like who tries to break into the Super 8 bathroom??! We weren’t expecting much from a motel, but we were expecting more than this. Go to the Motel 6 instead if you need a cheap place to stay. It has to be better. Location is great though. Access to free shuttles. IHOP, Denny’s, and mini golf right there. Grocery stores nearby. Beds are decent. TV worked.

text.text:
Reservation made in January for 9 nights beginning in September 2025 (holidays).
On the plus side:
The rooms are spacious, equipped with a small refrigerator, microwave, coffee maker, and numerous USB ports. The bed was quite comfortable.
On the minus side:
Upon our arrival, construction was underway in the parking lot, and the pool was closed (it looked like a pond) throughout our stay.
One night, the construction lasted until 2 a.m., with the beeping of machinery, and we were given no warning. This was unacceptable and showed a great lack of respect from the managers, who did not apologize.
Since the reservation was made in January, they were obviously aware of the work schedule. No mention was made.
The sink drain was faulty.
The chandelier in the bathroom was missing. The light bulb and wires were visible.
The two ice machines were broken....

No problems with the staff, the room was cleaned, towels and toilet paper were replaced.

The reception and check-in desk were more than average.

Although the hotel is well located, this experience remains very average. I do not recommend it, given the other options in the surrounding area.

text.text:
I used Choice Rewards points to book a complimentary night at this hotel, and the experience has been nothing short of shocking. The front desk staff checked me in on their system, but then refused to actually give me a room unless I paid a $150 deposit — even though other guests were being charged $100 or less. When I asked why my deposit was higher, I was given no explanation at all.

To make matters worse, they never cancelled my reservation in the Choice system. They marked me as “checked in” and told Choice I was already in the room, which is completely false. Because of this, Choice customer service believed I was accommodated, and I was left outside in the cold and rain with nowhere to go late at night.

I’ve been a Choice Diamond member for almost 3 years, and I have NEVER been treated like this. I called Choice multiple times for help, and I was hung up on repeatedly because the hotel was reporting that I was already checked into my room. Meanwhile, I was literally outside the property with my luggage, soaking wet and freezing.

The room is not double-booked, not unavailable, and not occupied whatsoever the front desk simply refused to honor my reward stay while still keeping me marked as checked in. This is extremely shady behavior and feels like the property is scamming Choice by claiming guests are in rooms that they never provided.
There was no compassion, no problem-solving, no attempt to help, and no honesty. Just refusal, runaround, and misrepresentation.

I have stayed at Choice properties across the country for years without issues, so I am genuinely stunned by the treatment I received here. I will not return to this location, and I strongly urge other Choice members to be cautious when booking this property.

text.text:
Disappointing stay - unbearably loud room!

​We chose Motel 6 because we were traveling with our two dogs and usually appreciate the brand for providing a clean, quiet, and affordable place to crash. I’ve had great experiences with Motel 6 in the past, but this location was a letdown. We booked a "premium" double room (includes a fridge and microwave) and checked out after just one night.

​The main issue was room 253. The AC blower fan is completely shot. I ran a dB meter, and it averaged 73.5 dB—equivalent to sleeping next to a running vacuum cleaner. We had to choose between being cool or having quiet, which made sleeping nearly impossible.

​Aside from the noise, the room seemed fine, though the rest of the property was kinda dirty. We tried this location because the Winter Park Motel 6 we stayed at recently was packed, and this one was a little cheaper and emptier. Hopefully, this was just a fluke with a bad room, but management seriously needs to pull room 253 from service until that fan is replaced.

text.text: Stay away from this location!!  It looks good on the outside, don't let it fool you.  Worst Motel 6 I've seen in a long time. Very strong pesticide smell. We could see what looked like mold in bathroom ceiling. Hallway carpets were disgustingly dirty, almost black on the first floor. We went into the room. I quickly used the bathroom (we had been on the road a couple hours to get there), that's when I saw the mold. I immediately went back to the desk, hadn't even brought in any luggage. I quietly informed the clerk of my concerns and that I could not stay there. I asked for a refund. I was told that because I used the bathroom I could not get a refund. She said that I was in the room for over half an hour (a lie, we didn't even sit on the bed because we didn't feel that the room was clean enough). Of course the manager wasn't available and there was no one in charge I could talk to. They would not give even a partial refund, and I realized later that the number she gave me to call did not have enough numbers to be a real number. Once home from vacation I called corporate and was told that only the management at the location could help me or issue a refund. I called the location and again no manager available and no way or time when I could talk to him later. No offer to take a message. Just, we can't give you a refund. I will not be using a Motel 6 ever again. The customer service was as bad as the nasty room and hallway.

text.text: I was assigned to this hotel by Hotwire.  It is listed as a 2.5 star hotel, but it really is a one star hotel - similar to a half-way house.  It has long-term tenants, and it smelled really bad.  The carpets were really dirty, paint peeling off of the doors, broken door locks on exterior doors, the elevator was broken and there was a shopping cart at the front entrance.  Our neighbors tried to get into our room through the adjoining door and there was a domestic dispute in the hall-way.  When we checked out a half hour after check-in, the front desk acted like this was not out of the ordinary which is also concerning.  On top of all of this, they won't refund my room rate because they said "I used the room" by going into the room.  Horrible customer service, horrible hotel and they prey on out-of-towners as their business model.

text.text: It's not the best, but it's not the WORST. Although I was only here for one night so I can't say. But the reviews are.. there. Only book this motel if you're on a budget and/or absolutely need somewhere to stay the night. The walls are super thin, and you can hear everything. So if you're a light sleeper, good luckkk. The bathroom is kinda gross (at least in the room I was in; trying to be nice). But not like, "I can't use the bathroom" gross, you can just visibly see some stains. Also, my sink was clogged? Ummmmm... whatever I guess. The bed is comfortable, but the sheets are... questionable... I found some hair that wasn't mine. The hallways STINK. Not sure if it's the staff who don't clean or the people who...? But anyways, so far, two staff that I've encountered during my visit were nice. So there's that. I had a bed, I was able to shower, I was able to sleep (a bit); that's all that mattered to me. THANKFULLY, no one tried getting into my room? I saw a review saying that someone tried getting into theirs I was like, oh shit. But overall, I don't think I'd consider this my go-to. But if I ABSOLUTELY needed to, it's an option.

hotel_name: La Quinta Inn by Wyndham Orlando International Drive North

text.text: This is my second time staying at this hotel and it is one of my favorites. There are 3 reasons why which is the price, the location and the cleanliness. I traveled solo but this is a great hotel for couples as well or a family with teenage kids. It located right on international drive and not to far from the parks. Its also close to icon park. Its a great central location. The price is affordable and most importantly there is no parking fee. There are a lot of hotels who charge for parking in addition to the room reservation which I don't understand. If you traveling for business or leisure this a great place. The rooms are updated. The beds are comfortable not hard. The TV channels are good. I stayed 3 days and my room was cleaned and I had plenty of towels. I just want to emphasize that I traveled solo so my perspective is coming from that place. I've seen a lot of couples and solo travels at the hotel during my stay but not many families with little children so please keep that in mind. Either way its a great place because of location, price and cleanliness which are extremely important nowadays.

text.text: You get what you pay for but I was pleasantly surprised! The location of this hotel to Epic and the two other Universal parks was amazing. The hotel provides a free shuttle to IOA and US once in the morning and evening but those times weren’t great for us so we ubered very cheaply to each park and back. We never tried the hotel breakfast so I can’t speak on that. The rooms were clean, bed comfortable, and bathrooms recently renovated. It was very nice to have a fridge and a microwave in the room. The hallways and back staircase carpets were pretty gross and smelt bad but overall I would stay here again. Perfect for the parks!

text.text:
While the location of the hotel is very nicely put and it looks rather newly renovated, it was not pleasant at all to find big cockroaches in the room. The breakfast is rather bland and you do not have a lot of things to choose from.

The customer service is sometimes good, that is because it depends on who is working at the front desk. The cleaning staff is amazing and really kind.

It is weird to not have any shower gel in the room and the problem to be that “it is sold out everywhere, so you have to wash with soap instead”.

I don’t know if this was a technical error or not, but the phone from the room rang at different hours in the night, waking us up in the middle of it.

Maybe a little more attention to details will work. And also don’t forget to train all of your employees the same customer experience.
